notes: flavor = lore lines before souls / Essence / Player Kills, skipping enchant lines and blanks
match: join the flavor lines with spaces, compare letters and digits only
needs_item_id: tell apart by tool type, not material
restyle the current name, gradient = first to last color
sharpness = what it drops with, only levels above it count as spent
status wiki = from the wiki, no style, flavor may be slightly off
does = what it does, source = where it comes from, info draft = written from the wiki and not checked by a player yet (hidden unless debug is on)

items.name: Lava Bolt
flavor: And so Notch the Archmage said
items.does: Creates a large pit of lava. Uses a Fire Soul.

items.name: Cupid's Bow
flavor: The wounds invisible that
Love's keen arrows make.
items.does: Arrows give regeneration to whoever they hit. Used to heal teammates.

items.name: Falken Blitz
flavor: We require more arrows.
items.does: Shoots several arrows at once in a slight spread. Works from the off hand.

items.name: Frost Bow
flavor: The wind spirits love
disrupting the balance of powers.
To that end, they have blessed this bow with
near-supersonic ice shots.
items.does: Shoots almost instantly. Each shot uses an Ice Soul.

items.name: Ichaival
flavor: A bow possessed by Odin.
items.does: No special ability. Has a kill counter.

items.name: Indra
flavor: A poet is someone who stands outside in
the rain hoping to be struck by lightning.
items.does: Arrows strike lightning on impact: one bolt in clear weather, a cluster in the rain.

items.name: Minibow
flavor: Called Mini in comparison to its prototype,
the Repeating Ballista commonly found
on Raider Caravels.
Works by accelerating time around the bow,
which is more energy efficient than reversing time,
but does not conserve the arrows.
December 2022
items.does: Shoots extremely fast and burns through arrows.

items.name: Nepenthes
flavor: A conjured bow said to create
a rift between dimensions
items.does: Shoots charged creepers instead of arrows.

items.name: Ragnaros
flavor: YOU AND YOUR KIND THOUGHT THAT THE
FIRES OF DOOM HAD BEEN QUENCHED.
items.does: Arrows leave lava where they land.

items.name: Robin's Bow
flavor: Robin liked stealing from the rich
and also giving it to the poor.

items.name: Santa's Rage
flavor: Favorite tool of the Jolly Man
to grief the shit out of
naughty kids and adults.

items.name: Sicario
flavor: Order is the best we can hope for.
items.does: Arrows bind and slow the target.

consuming DN above all else.

items.name: Rift Dragon Boots
flavor: Not much is known about
the elusive Rift Dragon.

items.name: Shadowmancer's Boots
flavor: Enchanted with the deadly
necromancer essence.

items.name: Bloodmancer Chestplate

pointier ears and longer fangs.

items.name: Edge Lord's Chestplate

makes the wearer feel alive.

items.name: Shadowmancer's Chestplate
flavor: Rebuilt from a thousand
cursed enderbones.

items.name: Edge Lord's Leggings

come together to form pants.

items.name: Rift Dragon Leggings
flavor: Enchanted dragon scales
with blaze powder finish.

items.name: Shadowmancer's Leggings

items.name: Headshot

great treant by Syba himself.

items.name: Avidity

Some say the person was dead inside.
items.does: No special ability. Has a kill counter.

items.name: Lifestealer
flavor: A terrifying axe that is said
to fill the entire battlefield
with blood once it cuts flesh
items.does: Heals you for part of the damage you deal.

items.name: Syba's Sage Slayer
flavor: Mad wizards across multispawn
abhorred Syba for his tranquility.
items.does: Deals more damage the more souls the target has. Works from the off hand.

items.name: Frozen Boots
flavor: These boots have a disdain for ice.

items.name: Sleipnir
flavor: Named after Odins trusty steed.

items.name: Sponge Boots
flavor: Essentially a pair of extremely
talkative sponge creatures
that remain mysteriously dry
as long as they are alive.
items.does: Soaks up any water you touch.

items.name: Assault Cuirass

worn by warlords of Minewind.

items.name: Frozen Chestplate
flavor: Traditional Claus armor.

items.name: Abyssal Helm

his most prized and precious armor.
items.does: Unlimited breath underwater.

items.name: Frozen Helm

Santa's elf hunting squad.

items.name: Warm and Cozy Helmet
flavor: Attracts spirits of kindness to watch over you
and deflect one attack from any direction
whenever they can.
A fine, shimmering garment
woven using love magic.
Once bestowed by an old witch
onto her best pupil,
so that no stroke of unluck
could claim her life.

items.name: Ball Lightning Rod
flavor: A prank by Zeus
to puzzle scientists for millenia.
He uses this spell whenever
a scientist is not looking.
Lightning does more damage to wet things.

items.name: Baphomet
flavor: We must remember that
Satan has his miracles, too.
items.does: Hits everything in a 3x3 area around the target. Has two open essence slots.

items.name: Death Scythe
flavor: The Harvester of Souls.
items.does: Poisons, blinds and nauseates the target. Works from the off hand.

items.name: Elder Phantom Staff
flavor: Summon Elder Phantom, true ruler of the night sky.

items.name: Bani-shin reginsu
flavor: Mysterious leggings that automatically
adjusts its size as the wearer's size.

items.name: Frozen Leggings
flavor: Partly responsible for ice age.

items.name: Ice Tights
flavor: Made of enchanted icicles.

items.name: Corrupted Diggity
flavor: Possessed by Satan
items.does: A Diggity with Fortune X.

items.name: Diggity
flavor: It is said that only one skilled
in metalworking can properly
wield this pickaxe.
items.does: Mines faster than any vanilla pickaxe.

items.name: Multipass
flavor: One Tool that lets you
pass through anything
items.does: One tool that becomes a sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, flint and steel, trident or shears as needed.

items.name: Obsidian Destroyer
flavor: One pickaxe to dig them all
items.does: Mines blocks instantly. Works from the off hand.

items.name: Shadow Swarm Pickaxe
flavor: Summons a spider assassin clan
from the Great Jungle.
Feared for their hallucinogenic venom,
they cloak themselves in shadow
upon sensing the slightest glimmer of light.

items.name: Elemental Shovel
flavor: A shovel of balance and a symbol
of peace in the Realm,
which must be kept to stand a chance
in surviving its destructive Elements.

items.name: Bone Spirit Sword
flavor: Summons suicidal spirits of death.

items.name: Dyrnwyn
flavor: When drawn
it blazed with fire.
items.note: vampiric copy had essences on it
items.does: A starter god sword with strong knockback.

items.name: Ice Katana
flavor: Forged by an unlucky runesmith
to preserve his zombified wife until
better resurrection magic was invented.
items.does: Hits freeze the target at full strength.

items.name: Mysteltainn
flavor: One-handed sword similar to the
legendary twig which was rumored
to have murdered Baldur,
the God of Light.
items.does: Inflicts Wither III on hit.

items.name: Summon Skeleton Scout Sword
flavor: Summon dead homies
back from the grave.

items.name: Torquem
flavor: Existence without you
has been torment
items.does: Binds the target and builds strength with repeated hits. The bind does not stop teleports.

items.name: Rift Dragon Head
flavor: Weird how it still moves.

items.name: Honey Master Bee Wings
flavor: The Honey Master grew bug wings
to be closer with the Queen,
but she perceived it as rivalry.
After the blood and guts have settled,
the War Bees lifted their champion
onto the Amber Throne.

items.name: Mana Wings
flavor: Wings that an ancient wizard
won in a duel with the Mana Satan.

items.name: Orc Hero Wings
flavor: Grug's wings awarded by
an orc general for bravery,
despite his insanity.

items.name: Rift Dragon Wings
flavor: Was once a part of a greater dragon.

items.name: Robin's Elytra
flavor: Robin loved scoutin'
rich neighborhoods from above.

items.name: Wind Elytra
flavor: Lightweight demon butterfly wings.
In flight, its wearer becomes Wind itself:
nigh invisible and resistant to explosion damage.
items.does: Makes the wearer invisible and resistant to explosions.

items.name: Wings of Blood
flavor: Wings of a fallen demon,
made entirely of screaming victims.

items.name: Salty
flavor: With patience comes great reward.
items.does: Fishing rod with Luck of the Sea X and Lure VIII.

items.name: Ceremonial Axe
flavor: Used for beheading.
items.does: Beheads players: a kill drops the victim's head.

items.name: War Bee Axe
flavor: Genetically engineered for maximum hatred,
they can sting more than once.
Indeed, they sting until
nothing remains.

items.name: Anti-Mage's Chestplate
flavor: The stout heart knows no fear!
items.does: Greatly reduces magic damage taken.

items.name: Odin's Blessing
flavor: From the perspective of Odin the All-Seeing,
when the body is hidden, the soul becomes revealed.
This blessing extends to his followers,
who value knowledge and wisdom above all else.
items.does: Shows invisible players as particles.

items.name: Glass Cannon
flavor: Doctor Hu's first prototype
on Peaceful Griefing.
items.does: Shoots a ball that turns a small area into rainbow glass.

items.name: Honey Cannon
flavor: Does not destroy your enemies immediately,
but kills them slowly with diabetes.
items.does: Creates a patch of honey blocks. Uses a Nature Soul.

items.name: Bush Magic
flavor: A blessing from the god Min
upon his hungry followers.
They turned the food into a weapon,
so he cursed them with raining frogs.
The frog meat was even more delicious.

items.name: Erozenith
flavor: Bends the electromagnetic current to strike
lightning in the same spot repeatedly.
A spell adapted by Zeus
when a mortal lightning sorceress tried to charm him
using a similar but weaker spell.
Where she aimed to gently excite her target's neurons
by channeling the static electricity around them,
Zeus realized he could do the same
but on a whole different level.

items.name: Netheramber
flavor: A sharp piece of pure Honey Amber,
solidified under immense tectonic pressure
of the volcanic Nether regions.
It spent three eternities in the treasury
of Osiris, from where it was traded
to the Travelling Merchant for
his smartest talking llama.
The llama studied architecture and
designed the first Nether Fortress.

items.name: Fire Blast Axe
flavor: Summons a detonating fire.

items.name: Pushpa Sangama
flavor: An ancient spell of Nature
devised by an elder sage
for his soul.
Summons a field of nice flowers.
Rare magic born from pure love of beauty,
it can still be corrupted for war.
Indeed, wizard assassins are known to have
exotic ways to bend flowers
to their deadly will.

items.name: Succulent
flavor: You cannot eat while being eaten.
items.does: Hits stop the target from eating.

items.name: Tornado Axe
flavor: Found occuring naturally in Great Plains,
tornadoes are lesser known as
the Breath of Vayu, god of the winds.
Not all tornadoes occur from Vayu,
so it is not entirely correct
to blame the god every time one happens.

items.name: Iron Maiden
flavor: An instrument used for torture,
only a fool would wear it.

items.name: Syba's Ancestral Chestplate
flavor: Contains the spirit of Syba's ancestors,
fills this armor with unstoppable rage.

items.name: Death Marker Dagger Staff
flavor: Coated in material so radioactive,
those who are struck glow through walls
in addition to being very poisoned.

items.name: Ice Shinto Staff
flavor: Concentrated anger
of a snow apparition.

items.name: Jack
flavor: Accursed hook mostly used
to put meat on display.
items.does: Turns you invisible when you teleport.

items.name: ShadowSaw Staff
flavor: It rips you apart from the outside.

items.name: Trap Chicken Staff
flavor: Abomination spell that creates a chicken,
but with a heart of molten rock
that explodes upon excitement.
It creates a suffering creature,
so this spell is banned
by all wizard academies except
the infamous Clown College,
a school for wizard hitmen.

items.name: Leggings of Increased Infinity Placed

the ceremonial Leggings strengthens their connection
to infinity.
items.does: Increases how many infinity blocks you place at once.

items.name: Death Marker Dagger Shovel
flavor: Coated in material so radioactive,
those who are struck glow through walls
in addition to being very poisoned.

items.name: Backstabber
flavor: Sweet screams of death
are best heard from behind.
items.does: Deals double damage when hitting from behind. Works from the off hand.

items.name: Blessed Snow Sword
flavor: Protects an area from projectiles.

items.name: Crippling Dagger
flavor: Envenomed with deadly STDs!

items.name: Noegrus
flavor: Cut my heart into pieces!
July 2026

items.name: Robin's Silver Sword
flavor: Robin Hood liked to live dangerously.

items.name: Syba's Katana

items.name: Vexer Sword

items.name: Zord

items.name: Bandit's Boots

items.name: Nature's Flips

is made of literal grass.
Very fashionable around druids.

items.name: Pyromancer's Boots
flavor: Infused with firm but
light dragon leather.

items.name: Aegis

over shoulders and arms.
items.does: A relic from the past. The Aegis spellbook used to need it and no longer does.

items.name: Divine Cloth
flavor: A holy garment that
was produced through
series of religious rituals
August 2025

items.name: Grug's Shirt
flavor: Grug's favorite green shirt.
Only Grug's girlfriend is allowed to wear it.

items.name: Honey Master Chestplate

from the sweetest depths of hell
by a traveling wizard.
It remains unknown why the Demon Bees
created a human-shaped armor.

items.name: Pyromancer's Tunic
flavor: Attire of pyromancers
from the Hathor cult.

items.name: Robin's Tunic
flavor: The hero lived in a forest
because he couldn't stop looting.

items.name: Grug's Hat
flavor: A fine leather hat of the beloved orc Grug.
Keeps the blood off Grug's shining buzz.

items.name: Leather of Talpa

with immortal lizard's skin.

items.name: Pyromancer's Hood

hood attract angry souls.

items.name: Robin's Cap
flavor: Robin Hood couldn't go a day
without Robin' The Hood

items.name: Grug's Pants

They smell pretty good, very orc.

items.name: Lightning God Pajamas
flavor: Zeus does not follow fashion,
it follows Zeus.

items.name: Nature's Slacks
flavor: It's like wearing nothing at all.

items.name: Pyromancer's Tights

that symbolizes fire mastery.

items.name: Syba's Jaguar Leggings

catching up to Syba's swift bhops.

items.name: Ghastchan Axe

that adds a chance to free cast spells
as long as it is alive.
Believing itself to be better than all violent creatures,
it does not cause harm directly,
but the wizards they often accompany
are still the #1 cause of natural disasters
accross the planes.

items.name: Merman's Mukluk
flavor: Tritons later became generic mermen.

items.name: Necromancer's Boots
flavor: Footwear made by Satin himself.
The soles are filled with giant's blood.
items.does: Gives absorption while standing on sacred blocks.

items.name: Necromancer's Chestplate
flavor: Compressed giant's carcass
that smells pretty good.
items.does: Gives strength while standing on sacred blocks.

items.name: Ripper
flavor: Special sickle for
extracting innards quickly.
items.does: Teleports you behind your target. Stopped by bind and Ice Domain.

items.name: Tornado Staff
flavor: Found occuring naturally in Great Plains,
tornadoes are lesser known as
the Breath of Vayu, god of the winds.
Not all tornadoes occur from Vayu,
so it is not entirely correct
to blame the god every time one happens.

items.name: Fire Spiral Shovel
flavor: Unleashes a fire essence from hell.

items.name: Daemon Sword
flavor: Embedded with three blasphemous
gems, hearts of Greater Daemons who
could use all magic freely.
Their hearts only cast darkness, however.

items.name: Occultist's Blade
flavor: A fine blade made of wither bone.

the spot most barbers refuse to shave.

big enough to fit human head.

items.name: Giant Snowball
flavor: Devised by a sadistic wizard
to torture his enemies.

items.name: Necromancer's Mask
flavor: Originally worn by Steve The Eternal.
items.does: Permanent night vision.

items.name: Isfet Nebu
flavor: The runed scepter of Apophis, god of Chaos.
Uses the energy of a Dragon Egg
to summon a meteor storm by a celestial portal.
It is said Meteor Storms come from the edge
of a nearby star that has been violently consuming
its solar system for at least 1337 years.
The remains of an ancient civilization
might be falling from the sky.

items.name: Elder Branch
flavor: A twig which contains the
mysterious power of eternity
items.does: Each hit summons copies of the sword that fight for you. Only works at night.

items.name: Aku bani
flavor: Made out of evil bunnies.

items.name: Alchemist's Wings
flavor: Developed by alchemist guild to aid with nether research.

items.does: Full set: more backstab and melee damage, and sneaking makes you invisible.

items.does: Full set: more backstab and melee damage, and sneaking makes you invisible.

items.does: Full set: more backstab and melee damage, and sneaking makes you invisible.

items.name: Azurite Helm
flavor: We'll not be lured into the darkness so easily.

items.name: Bab-ilu
flavor: The things we can't obtain are the most beautiful ones. -Gilgamesh
items.does: Mythical. Shoots a barrage of magic daggers.

items.name: Bandit's Bow
flavor: Standard issue Bandit bow. Stolen from a hunter village.
items.does: Arrows slow and poison the target.

items.name: Bandit's Glider
flavor: Goes well with the Jump Rod!

items.name: Brynhild
flavor: An Armor which is made of a metal unknown in overworld.

items.name: Builder's Hat
flavor: Enchanted with the lifeforce of spectral turtle dragons.
items.does: Mythical. Grants creative flight.

items.name: Cursed Dragontooth
flavor: A cursed blade forged out of dragon's tooth, known to cause insanity to whoever may wield it.
items.does: No special ability. Has Curse of Vanishing.

items.name: Devilfish
flavor: Contains the power of over 9000 fish! Caught by: CntyMcShttr Player Kills: 1027

items.name: Diabolus Armor
flavor: The small Satan left and the great Satan came.

items.name: Dimension Anomaly Tools
flavor: Creates endermatic anomaly seething with disdain for teleportation, warping the very fabric of space to punish those who dare to blink through dimensions.
items.does: Summons a rift that catches anyone teleporting nearby and damages them heavily.

items.name: Dragon Knight's Boots
flavor: These were used to tread across a million dead goblins.

items.name: Dragon Knight's Shield
flavor: Crafted from top quality wood, iron and dragon scales, at Minewind blacksmite.
items.does: Heals you when you block an attack.

items.name: Dragon Knight's Sword
flavor: A grand dragon's sword snatched for adventure. Right click to unleash it's power
items.does: Shoots a fireball, using a Dragon Soul. Deals more damage while mounted.

items.name: Dragon Knight's Wings
flavor: The knight thought he defeated the dragon, but the serpent took him for a vessel.

items.name: Edge Lords Wings
flavor: Razor blade shaped, very hip.

items.name: Empeiria
flavor: Strength lies not in defence but in attack.
items.does: Hits steal experience levels from the target.

items.name: Exploding Seenk
flavor: A dangerous contraption made by a crazed engineer. Straps live explosives to every arrow.
items.does: Bolts explode and burn on impact.

items.name: Fragarach
flavor: That Which Comes Later Cuts First
items.does: An event item from Christmas 2016.

items.name: Frosty Boots
flavor: Mysterious shoes from the north pole.

items.name: Gravitas
flavor: Gravity explains the motions of the planets, but it cannot explain who sets the planets in motion.
items.does: Arrows make the target levitate.

items.name: Grug's Boots
flavor: Grug like to go fast and also hard.

items.name: Hawkwood's Chain Helm
flavor: This helm makes you admire the power of dragons. You're not quite sure why.

items.name: Hermes Boots
flavor: Boots of the trickster god who prized cleverness and amusement above all else.
items.does: Mythical. Grants flight.

items.name: Holy Cross
flavor: Unholy things have been done to it.
items.does: Mythical. Like an Elder Branch that works day and night and summons wither skeletons.

items.name: Honey Master Boots
flavor: Amber boots perpetually covered in Bee Juice. The Honey Master could not know smelling this good was both a blessing and a curse.

items.name: Honey Master Head
flavor: The First Honey Master believed he was one of the bees. To become a Honey Amber was the greatest honor a Queen could bestow.

items.name: Honey Master Leggings
flavor: Amber leggings woven from the intoxicating blood of a Queen Bee.

items.name: Hunter's Bow
flavor: Top quality bow from the hunter's village.
items.does: Starter gear with no special ability.

items.name: Hunter's Elytra
flavor: Passed down to the best marksmen from the hunters village.

items.name: Hunter's Pupil Hat
flavor: Made of the pupils first prey, a supple squarrel. This hat holds a secret skill of the hunter's village. Activate it to become a houndmaster.

items.name: Hunter's Pupil Pants
flavor: Comfy fur from mountain goat. Unlock the hidden power of these pants! Mysterious hunter skill awaits. Master it to unleash improved mobility.

items.name: Hunter's Pupil Shirt
flavor: Skin used to belong to an extinct creature.

items.name: Infirmity
flavor: A bow imbued with the sacred essence of death.
items.does: Arrows cripple the target with slowness and weakness.

items.name: Kiga
flavor: They that die by famine die by inches
items.does: Hits starve the target.

items.name: Lightbringer
flavor: Finders Keeper

items.name: Lightning God Glider
flavor: Zeus did not need these to fly, but it made him feel like a bird and a mortal.

items.name: Lightning God Robe
flavor: Zeus prefers to bare his chest whenever possible, so he traded this modest-leaning heavenly robe to Herobrine for an unknown favor.

items.name: Lightning God Sandals
flavor: Favorite heavenwear of Zeus that draw all focus onto his lightning-hard thighs.

items.name: Lightning Head Rod
flavor: Nothing refreshes the memory like 300 million Volts to the brain. Plugs into your Neuralink socket, enhancing your feel for lightning.

items.name: Mage Apprentice Boots
flavor: The best shoes an apprentice mage could afford.

items.name: Mage Apprentice Hat
flavor: Keeps you warm at night, and also contains fire magic.

items.name: Mage Apprentice Tights
flavor: Self cleaning magical pants, always smell like mana.

items.name: Mage Apprentice Tunic
flavor: Gifted by a great wizard upon accepting an apprentice.

items.name: Mani's Blessing
flavor: A helm that is said to have been worn by the god of the moon

items.name: Mask of Aurelian
flavor: A Golden Helmet once worn by the Restorer of the World during his blazing Conquests.
items.does: Mythical. Repairs your items with every kill.

items.name: Misery
flavor: No One Here Gets Out Alive
items.does: Mythical. Cripples the target.

items.name: Nature's Elytra
flavor: Bestowed upon a very kind druid by the spirits.

items.name: Nature's Garb
flavor: A living armor that was woven by trees themselves!

items.name: Nature's Headress
flavor: Made of leaves but provides a connection with nature.

items.name: Necromancer's Leggings
flavor: Used in countless wars against Ydahs Tar's tribe.
items.does: Gives regeneration while standing on sacred blocks.

items.name: Orc Fork
flavor: A common orc sport is to see how much you can destroy with a single throw.
items.does: Trident that explodes on impact.

flavor: Sharp as fuck

items.name: Queen's Whip
flavor: Causes severe pain

items.name: Rage of Zeus
flavor: Devises by an adolescent Zeus in his angry years, for everything was scorched anyway. Lightning does more damage to wet things.
items.does: Fires a line of lightning at the target. Only deals damage in rain or water. Uses two Nature Souls.

items.name: Stick of Truth
flavor: Doesn't do anything
items.does: Mythical. Does nothing special.

items.name: Stone Dagger
flavor: A heavy long dagger, popular amongst Minewind hunters.
items.does: Starter gear with no special ability.

items.name: Syba's Pet Turtle
flavor: When his master was in danger, Syba's Great Turtle heroically turned himself into a magical helmet.
items.does: No special ability.

items.name: Syba's Satan Shoes
flavor: Syba's life force can still be felt, trapped in these boots.

items.name: Syba's Touch
flavor: So gentle, it can even pick up a spawner sometimes.
items.does: Can pick up spawners, but not every time.

items.name: Syba's Training Sword
flavor: Syba holds deeply the spirit of sharing.
items.does: Hits pull your experience level and the target's closer together.

items.name: Telekinetic Multipass
flavor: One Tool that lets you pass through anything. Also allows you to place blocks telepathically from your other hand.
items.does: A Multipass that places off-hand blocks up to 16 blocks away, even in mid-air.

items.name: Untouchable Chest
flavor: Stylish Chest, makes the wearer irresistibly charming, causing enemies to hesitate and feel guilty for attacking such a mesmerizing figure.
items.does: Attackers get Mining Fatigue IV for one second per level.

items.name: Untouchable Leggings
flavor: Stylish Leggings, makes the wearer irresistibly charming, causing enemies to hesitate and feel guilty for attacking such a mesmerizing figure.
